Card.signature: Card(children: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Alert | Badge | Avatar | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | Progress | Separator | BarChart | LineChart | AreaChart | PieChart | RadarChart | RadialChart | ScatterChart | WaterfallChart | SunburstChart | TreemapChart | FunnelChart | SankeyChart | GaugeChart | HeatmapChart | MapChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | Heading | Blockquote | InlineCode | PaginationBlock | DialogBlock | AlertDialogBlock | DrawerBlock | CalendarBlock | Command | Combobox | HoverCard | Tooltip | Popover | Collapsible | ToggleGroup | Sheet | Resizable | ScrollArea | Sonner | Skeleton | Spinner | Empty | Field | Breadcrumb | NavigationMenu | DropdownMenu | ContextMenu | Menubar | Kbd | AspectRatio | ButtonGroup | InputGroup | FollowUpBlock | Tabs | Carousel)[])
Card.description: Vertical container for all content in a chat response. Children stack top to bottom automatically.

CardHeader.description: Title/description header block for a Card.

TextContent.description: Text block with optional size. size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy". Cite inline as [n] and the app renders a clickable badge.

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with GFM support and clickable [n] citation badges.

Alert.description: Alert banner with icon, title, and description. variant: "default" | "destructive" | "info" | "success" | "warning".

Avatar.signature: Avatar(src?: string, alt?: string, fallback: string)
Avatar.description: Circular avatar with image and fallback text.

CodeBlock.signature: CodeBlock(code: string, language?: string, title?: string)
CodeBlock.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with optional language and title.

Image.description: Displays an image with optional alt text.

ImageBlock.signature: ImageBlock(src: string, alt?: string, caption?: string)

Progress.description: Progress bar showing completion percentage (0-100). Optional label.

Table.signature: Table(columns: Col[], rows: any[][], title?: string, caption?: string)
Table.description: Data table. title: what the table shows (e.g. 'Baseline characteristics by arm'); columns: Col[] with header/type/unit; rows: 2D array of values; caption: source, n, or caveat. Every numeric column should carry its unit.

Col.description: Column definition for Table. header: column name; type: string | number | boolean (numbers are right-aligned); unit: measurement unit shown after the header (e.g. mg, %, RR, 95% CI).

BarChart.signature: BarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], variant?: "grouped" | "stacked", xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean, showValues?: boolean})
BarChart.description: Vertical bars comparing a value across categories, or a stacked composition. Use to rank or compare discrete groups. Set meta.title, meta.unit, and both axis labels.

LineChart.signature: LineChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean, showValues?: boolean})
LineChart.description: Line chart for a trend across an ordered axis, often time. Use when the shape of change matters more than individual points. Set meta.title, meta.unit, and both axis labels.

AreaChart.signature: AreaChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean, showValues?: boolean})
AreaChart.description: Filled area chart emphasising magnitude or cumulative volume over an ordered axis. Use for totals/volume, not precise comparisons. Set meta.title, meta.unit, and both axis labels.

RadarChart.signature: RadarChart(labels: string[], series: Series[], meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean, showValues?: boolean})
RadarChart.description: Radar/spider comparing entities across the same 3-8 dimensions on one 0-100 scale. Never mix units on a radar. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

Series.description: One named data series with values matching labels.

PieChart.signature: PieChart(slices: Slice[], donut?: boolean, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean, showValues?: boolean})
PieChart.description: Pie or donut for parts of a whole at one point in time (2-7 slices). Use a bar chart or Table when the reader must compare exact values. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

RadialChart.signature: RadialChart(slices: Slice[], meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean, showValues?: boolean})
RadialChart.description: Radial bar (concentric rings) for a small ranked set on independent scales or progress per category. Use a bar chart when values share one scale. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

Slice.description: A single slice in a PieChart or RadialChart.

ScatterChart.signature: ScatterChart(series: ScatterSeries[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean, showValues?: boolean})
ScatterChart.description: Scatter relating two numeric variables, one point per study. Use to show correlation, clusters, or effect against a baseline. Label both axes and their units in meta.

ScatterSeries.description: Named scatter series with Point references.

Point.signature: Point(x: number, y: number, label?: string)
Point.description: A single data point in a ScatterChart series.

WaterfallChart.signature: WaterfallChart(items: WaterfallItem[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean})
WaterfallChart.description: Waterfall: how a starting value moves through signed increments to a final total. Use for additive effect decomposition. Mark the last bar total: true. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

WaterfallItem.signature: WaterfallItem(category: string, value: number, total?: boolean)
WaterfallItem.description: One step in a WaterfallChart. category: step label; value: signed change (negative decreases); total: true renders the running cumulative total bar.

SunburstChart.signature: SunburstChart(nodes: SunburstNode[], meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean})
SunburstChart.description: Sunburst: a two-to-four level part-of-whole hierarchy as concentric rings. Use for nested categories; use a pie chart for a flat one-level split. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

SunburstNode.signature: SunburstNode(name: string, value?: number, parent?: string)
SunburstNode.description: One node of a SunburstChart hierarchy. name: unique label; value: leaf size (omit for branch nodes); parent: parent node name (omit for a root).

TreemapChart.signature: TreemapChart(nodes: TreemapNode[], meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean})
TreemapChart.description: Treemap: nested part-of-whole as area-proportional rectangles. Use when many categories or two levels must fit at once; pair with a Table for exact values. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

TreemapNode.signature: TreemapNode(name: string, value?: number, parent?: string)
TreemapNode.description: One node of a TreemapChart hierarchy. name: unique label; value: leaf size; parent: parent node name (omit for a root).

FunnelChart.signature: FunnelChart(stages: FunnelStage[], meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean})
FunnelChart.description: Funnel: progressive attrition through ordered stages (screened > eligible > included > analysed). Use for any screening or selection flow. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

FunnelStage.description: One stage in a FunnelChart. name: stage label; value: stage count.

SankeyChart.signature: SankeyChart(nodes: FlowNode[], links: FlowLink[], meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean})
SankeyChart.description: Sankey: how quantities flow between stages or groups. Use for movement/allocation, never simple category totals. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

FlowNode.description: One node (source or target) in a SankeyChart. name: unique label used by FlowLink.

FlowLink.signature: FlowLink(source: string, target: string, value: number)
FlowLink.description: One flow in a SankeyChart. source/target: FlowNode names; value: flow magnitude.

GaugeChart.signature: GaugeChart(value: number, max?: number, label?: string, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean})
GaugeChart.description: Gauge: one headline number against a maximum (pooled estimate, certainty score, completion). Use only for a single KPI, never comparisons. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

HeatmapChart.signature: HeatmapChart(cells: HeatCell[], xLabel?: string, yLabel?: string, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean})
HeatmapChart.description: Heatmap matrix: a value at every row x column combination (e.g. outcome x study). Use to expose patterns and gaps across two categorical axes. Always label both axes. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

HeatCell.signature: HeatCell(x: string, y: string, value: number)
HeatCell.description: One cell in a HeatmapChart. x: column label; y: row label; value: cell magnitude.

MapChart.signature: MapChart(points?: MapPoint[], regions?: MapRegion[], region?: string, meta?: {title?: string, caption?: string, unit?: string, legend?: boolean, roam?: boolean})
MapChart.description: World map for geographic evidence: shaded countries (regions) and/or located study sites (points). Use for geographic distribution or country-level rates. Any country shading must come from a cited numeric value.

MapPoint.signature: MapPoint(lat: number, lng: number, label?: string, value?: number)
MapPoint.description: One marker on a MapChart. lat/lng: coordinates in decimal degrees; label: place or study name; value: optional magnitude used for the marker size and tooltip.

MapRegion.signature: MapRegion(name: string, value: number, label?: string)
MapRegion.description: One shaded country on a MapChart. name: country name in common English (United States, China, Brazil); value: magnitude that drives the color scale; label: optional display name.

Form.signature: Form(name: string, buttons: Buttons, fields?: FormControl[])
Form.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons. fields: FormControl[], buttons: Buttons.

FormControl.description: Wraps a form field with a label and error display.

Label.description: Form label. Optionally links to an input via htmlFor.

Input.signature: Input(name: string, placeholder?: string, type?: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url", rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string})
Input.description: Text input field. type: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url". rules for validation.

TextArea.signature: TextArea(name: string, placeholder?: string, rows?: number, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string})
TextArea.description: Multi-line text input. rows sets visible height. rules for validation.

Select.signature: Select(name: string, items: SelectItem[], placeholder?: string, rules?: {required?: boolean, email?: boolean, url?: boolean, numeric?: boolean, min?: number, max?: number, minLength?: number, maxLength?: number, pattern?: string})
Select.description: Dropdown select. items: SelectItem[], placeholder, rules for validation.

DatePicker.description: Date selection input with calendar popover.

Slider.signature: Slider(name: string, min?: number, max?: number, step?: number, defaultValue?: number)
Slider.description: Range slider input. min, max, step, defaultValue.

SwitchGroup.description: Group of toggle switches. items: SwitchItem[].

Button.signature: Button(label: string, action?: {type: "open_url", url: string} | {type: "continue_conversation", context?: string} | {type: string, params?: Record<string, any>}, variant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link", size?: "default" | "xs" | "sm" | "lg" | "icon")
Button.description: Clickable button. variant: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link". size: "default" | "xs" | "sm" | "lg" | "icon". action: { type: "continue_conversation" | "open_url", url? }.

FollowUpBlock.description: List of follow-up suggestion chips at the end of a response.

FollowUpItem.description: Clickable follow-up suggestion — sends text as user message when clicked.

Tabs.description: Tabbed content. items: TabItem[]. defaultValue: initially active tab.

TabItem.signature: TabItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Alert | Badge | Avatar | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | Progress | Separator | BarChart | LineChart | AreaChart | PieChart | RadarChart | RadialChart | ScatterChart | WaterfallChart | SunburstChart | TreemapChart | FunnelChart | SankeyChart | GaugeChart | HeatmapChart | MapChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | Heading | Blockquote | InlineCode | PaginationBlock | DialogBlock | AlertDialogBlock | DrawerBlock | CalendarBlock | Command | Combobox | HoverCard | Tooltip | Popover | Collapsible | ToggleGroup | Sheet | Resizable | ScrollArea | Sonner | Skeleton | Spinner | Empty | Field | Breadcrumb | NavigationMenu | DropdownMenu | ContextMenu | Menubar | Kbd | AspectRatio | ButtonGroup | InputGroup)[])
TabItem.description: Tab panel. value: unique id, trigger: tab label, content: children.

AccordionItem.signature: AccordionItem(value: string, trigger: string, content: (TextContent | MarkDownRenderer | CardHeader | Alert | Badge | Avatar | CodeBlock | Image | ImageBlock | Progress | Separator | BarChart | LineChart | AreaChart | PieChart | RadarChart | RadialChart | ScatterChart | WaterfallChart | SunburstChart | TreemapChart | FunnelChart | SankeyChart | GaugeChart | HeatmapChart | MapChart | Table | TagBlock | Form | Buttons | Heading | Blockquote | InlineCode | PaginationBlock | DialogBlock | AlertDialogBlock | DrawerBlock | CalendarBlock | Command | Combobox | HoverCard | Tooltip | Popover | Collapsible | ToggleGroup | Sheet | Resizable | ScrollArea | Sonner | Skeleton | Spinner | Empty | Field | Breadcrumb | NavigationMenu | DropdownMenu | ContextMenu | Menubar | Kbd | AspectRatio | ButtonGroup | InputGroup)[])
AccordionItem.description: Collapsible item inside Accordion. value: unique id, trigger: header text.

Carousel.description: Horizontal sliding content. slides: array of slide arrays. variant: "default" | "card".

TagBlock.description: Group of tags. Accepts string array or Tag references.

Blockquote.description: Styled blockquote. Optional cite for attribution.

InlineCode.description: Inline code snippet rendered with monospace font.

PaginationBlock.description: Page navigation. currentPage and totalPages control which pages are shown.

DialogBlock.signature: DialogBlock(triggerLabel: string, title: string, description?: string, content?: any[], triggerVariant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link")
DialogBlock.description: Modal dialog triggered by a button. triggerLabel: button text, title/description in header, content: children rendered inside.

AlertDialogBlock.signature: AlertDialogBlock(triggerLabel: string, title: string, description: string, confirmLabel?: string, cancelLabel?: string, triggerVariant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link")
AlertDialogBlock.description: Confirmation dialog with cancel and confirm buttons. Clicking confirm sends the confirmLabel as a message.

DrawerBlock.signature: DrawerBlock(triggerLabel: string, title: string, description?: string, content?: any[])
DrawerBlock.description: Bottom drawer panel triggered by a button. triggerLabel: button text, title/description in header, content: children rendered inside.

CalendarBlock.signature: CalendarBlock(mode?: "single" | "multiple" | "range", defaultMonth?: string, numberOfMonths?: number, captionLayout?: "label" | "dropdown")
CalendarBlock.description: Standalone calendar display. mode: "single" | "multiple" | "range". captionLayout: "label" | "dropdown" (default "dropdown"). numberOfMonths defaults to 1.

Command.signature: Command(placeholder?: string, items?: CommandItem[], empty?: string, dialog?: boolean)
Command.description: Evidence search palette (Cmd+K). placeholder: input hint; items: CommandItem[]; empty: no-results text; dialog: true renders a button that opens the palette modally.

CommandItem.signature: CommandItem(label: string, description?: string, keywords?: string, action?: {type: "open_url", url: string} | {type: "continue_conversation", context?: string} | {type: string, params?: Record<string, any>})
CommandItem.description: One selectable row in a Command palette. label: primary text; description: secondary text; keywords: extra search terms; action: fired on select.

Combobox.signature: Combobox(trigger: string, items?: ComboboxItem[], placeholder?: string, searchPlaceholder?: string)
Combobox.description: Searchable select for filtering studies (design, population, intervention). trigger: button label; items: ComboboxItem[]; placeholder: idle text; searchPlaceholder: input hint.

ComboboxItem.signature: ComboboxItem(value: string, label: string, description?: string, action?: {type: "open_url", url: string} | {type: "continue_conversation", context?: string} | {type: string, params?: Record<string, any>})
ComboboxItem.description: One option for Combobox. value: unique id; label: visible text; description: secondary text; action: fired on select.

ToggleGroup.signature: ToggleGroup(items?: string[], multiple?: boolean, defaultValue?: string)
ToggleGroup.description: Study-design filter as toggle buttons (e.g. RCT / Cohort / Case-control). items: labels; multiple: allow more than one on; defaultValue: initially active label. Never write "you can filter by..." in prose.

HoverCard.description: Citation preview on hover. trigger: the visible node (e.g. a Badge marker); content: nodes revealed in the card. Never repeat the full citation inline.

Tooltip.description: One-line definition shown on hover. trigger: the term node (e.g. TextContent 'GRADE certainty'); text: the definition. Never parenthesize definitions in prose.

Popover.description: Inline detail on click for a single data point. trigger: the clickable node; content: nodes shown in the floating panel. Use instead of a full Dialog for one number.

Collapsible.signature: Collapsible(trigger: any, content?: any[], defaultOpen?: boolean)
Collapsible.description: Single expandable section for nested evidence (e.g. subgroup analyses). trigger: header node; content: revealed nodes; defaultOpen: start expanded.

Sheet.signature: Sheet(trigger: string, side?: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left", title: string, description?: string, content?: any[])
Sheet.description: Side panel for full-text context without covering the answer. trigger: button text; side: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" (default right); title/description: header; content: panel nodes.

Resizable.description: Side-by-side evidence comparison with a draggable divider. panels: ResizablePanel[]; direction: "horizontal" | "vertical"; initialRatio: first-pane percent (2 panes only). Use instead of stacking two tables.

ResizablePanel.description: One pane of a Resizable. content: nodes rendered inside the pane.

ScrollArea.description: Fixed-height scroll region for long evidence lists, so the Card cannot grow unbounded. content: nodes; orientation: scroll axis; maxHeight: pixel cap (default 320).

Sonner.signature: Sonner(message: string, variant?: "default" | "success" | "error" | "warning" | "info", label?: string, description?: string)
Sonner.description: Transient toast for confirmations ("Citation copied", "Filter applied"). message: toast body; variant: tone; label: button text (default "Notify"); description: secondary line. Never use a permanent Alert for a transient confirmation.

Skeleton.signature: Skeleton(width?: string | number, height?: string | number, rounded?: "none" | "sm" | "md" | "lg" | "full")
Skeleton.description: Streaming placeholder. Match width/height to the component that will replace it to prevent layout shift. width/height accept px numbers or CSS strings; rounded: none | sm | md | lg | full.

Spinner.description: Inline loading indicator while a single passage resolves. label: optional text.

Empty.signature: Empty(title: string, description?: string, content?: any[])
Empty.description: Empty state when a filter returns zero studies, e.g. title "No RCTs match this population". title: headline; description: explanation; content: optional actions.

Field.signature: Field(label: string, control: any, description?: string)
Field.description: Generic form field wrapper when FormControl is too opinionated. label: field label; control: the input node; description: helper text.

Breadcrumb.description: Research trail showing how the evidence set was narrowed (Question > Filtered evidence (12) > Included studies (5) > Synthesis). items: BreadcrumbItem[]; the last item renders as the current page.

BreadcrumbItem.signature: BreadcrumbItem(label: string, href?: string, action?: {type: "open_url", url: string} | {type: "continue_conversation", context?: string} | {type: string, params?: Record<string, any>})
BreadcrumbItem.description: One step in a Breadcrumb. label: step text; href: link target; action: fired when a non-link step is clicked.

NavigationMenuItem.description: One top-level section. trigger: section label; content: nodes revealed in the dropdown.

DropdownMenu.signature: DropdownMenu(trigger: string, items?: DropdownMenuItem[], label?: string)
DropdownMenu.description: Row-level actions opened from a button. trigger: button text; items: DropdownMenuItem[]; label: optional group heading.

DropdownMenuItem.signature: DropdownMenuItem(label: string, action?: {type: "open_url", url: string} | {type: "continue_conversation", context?: string} | {type: string, params?: Record<string, any>}, variant?: "default" | "destructive", inset?: boolean)
DropdownMenuItem.description: One row action (e.g. "Show abstract", "Open in PubMed", "Exclude"). label: row text; action: fired on select; variant: "default" | "destructive".

ContextMenu.signature: ContextMenu(trigger: any, items?: ContextMenuItem[], label?: string)
ContextMenu.description: Right-click actions on a passage. trigger: the region node; items: ContextMenuItem[]; label: optional heading.

ContextMenuItem.signature: ContextMenuItem(label: string, action?: {type: "open_url", url: string} | {type: "continue_conversation", context?: string} | {type: string, params?: Record<string, any>}, variant?: "default" | "destructive", inset?: boolean)
ContextMenuItem.description: One right-click action (e.g. "Copy citation", "Highlight", "Compare"). label: row text; action: fired on select.

Menubar.description: Desktop-style menu bar for a full research console. menus: MenubarMenu[].

MenubarMenu.description: One top-level menubar menu. trigger: menu label; items: MenubarItem[].

MenubarItem.signature: MenubarItem(label: string, action?: {type: "open_url", url: string} | {type: "continue_conversation", context?: string} | {type: string, params?: Record<string, any>}, variant?: "default" | "destructive", inset?: boolean)
MenubarItem.description: One action inside a MenubarMenu. label: row text; action: fired on select.

Kbd.description: Keyboard shortcut display. keys: one string ("Cmd+K") or a string array rendered as a combo.

AspectRatio.description: Constrain an image thumbnail or forest-plot preview to a fixed ratio. ratio: width / height (e.g. 1.7778 for 16:9); content: nodes.

ButtonGroup.description: Group related actions without spacing, e.g. "Include / Exclude / Maybe" as one control. buttons: Button[].

InputGroup.signature: InputGroup(placeholder?: string, addonStart?: string, addonEnd?: string)
InputGroup.description: Input with addons, e.g. a search field with a leading filter label and a trailing hint. placeholder: input hint; addonStart/addonEnd: text on either side.

componentGroups.name: Charts (Advanced)
notes: Pick the chart by the data's shape, not by habit:
- Change to a running total -> WaterfallChart.
- Nested parts of a whole (2-4 levels) -> SunburstChart; a flat split -> PieChart.
- Many categories or two hierarchy levels -> TreemapChart; pair with a Table for exact values.
- Ordered attrition or screening stages -> FunnelChart.
- Movement between stages or groups -> SankeyChart.
- One KPI against a maximum -> GaugeChart.
- A value at every row x column combination -> HeatmapChart.

componentGroups.name: Maps
notes: - Use MapChart for geographic distribution: MapRegion for country-level shading, MapPoint for study sites.
- Every region value and point value must come from a cited passage; never invent coordinates or rates.
- Country names use common English (United States, China, Brazil); points use decimal lat/lng.

componentGroups.name: Forms
notes: - Define EACH FormControl as its own reference — do NOT inline all controls in one array.
- NEVER nest Form inside Form.
- Form requires explicit buttons. Always pass a Buttons(...) reference as the third Form argument.
- rules is an optional object: { required: true, email: true, min: 8, maxLength: 100 }
- The renderer shows error messages automatically — do NOT generate error text in the UI

componentGroups.name: Follow-ups
notes: - Use FollowUpBlock with FollowUpItem references at the end of a response to suggest next actions.
- Clicking a FollowUpItem sends its text to the LLM as a user message.

componentGroups.name: Layout
notes: - Use Tabs to present alternative views — each TabItem has a value id, trigger label, and content array.
- Carousel takes an array of slides, where each slide is an array of content.
- IMPORTANT: Every slide in a Carousel must have the same structure.

componentGroups.name: Typography
notes: - Heading levels: "h1" | "h2" | "h3" | "h4". Each renders with appropriate shadcn/ui typography styles.
- Blockquote for styled quotes with optional cite attribution.
- InlineCode for monospace code snippets within text.

componentGroups.name: Calendar
notes: - CalendarBlock renders a standalone interactive calendar. mode: "single" | "multiple" | "range".
- Use numberOfMonths to show multiple months side by side.
- Use defaultMonth (ISO date string) to set the initial visible month.

componentGroups.name: Navigation
notes: - PaginationBlock takes currentPage and totalPages.

componentGroups.name: Overlays
notes: - DialogBlock renders a button that opens a modal dialog with content inside.
- AlertDialogBlock renders a confirmation dialog with cancel/confirm actions.
- DrawerBlock renders a bottom drawer panel triggered by a button.

componentGroups.name: Evidence Search
notes: - Evidence search MUST be a Command palette (Cmd+K), never a prose instruction or a bare Input.
- Use ToggleGroup to filter by study design ("RCT" / "Cohort" / "Case-control"), never write "you can filter by..." in text.
- Use Combobox to pick a population, design, or intervention from a searchable list.

componentGroups.name: Citations & Terms
notes: - Cite inline as plain [n]; the application renders each as a clickable citation badge (author-year by default) and lists the references at the bottom. Never wrap a marker in HoverCard/Badge, add a citations column, or repeat the full citation inline.
- Wrap technical terms (GRADE certainty, RR) in a Tooltip with a one-line definition; never parenthesize the definition in prose.

componentGroups.name: Details & Disclosure
notes: - Single-point detail goes in a Popover, never a full DialogBlock.
- Nested evidence such as subgroup analyses goes in a Collapsible.
- Full-text context goes in a Sheet (side panel) so the answer stays visible.
- Side-by-side evidence goes in Resizable; never stack two tables meant to be compared.
- Long evidence lists go in ScrollArea; never let the Card grow unbounded.

componentGroups.name: Feedback & Loading
notes: - Streaming placeholders MUST be Skeleton sized like the eventual table/chart; never leave a blank region.
- Transient confirmations use Sonner, never a permanent Alert.
- When a filter returns zero studies, use Empty (e.g. "No RCTs match this population").

componentGroups.name: Research Navigation
notes: - Breadcrumb shows the research trail: Question > Filtered evidence (12) > Included studies (5) > Synthesis.
- DropdownMenu holds per-study row actions (Show abstract, Open in PubMed, Exclude).
- ContextMenu holds right-click passage actions (Copy citation, Highlight, Compare).
- Kbd shows shortcuts such as Cmd+K.

componentGroups.name: Utility
notes: - AspectRatio constrains image thumbnails and forest-plot previews.
- ButtonGroup groups related actions, e.g. "Include / Exclude / Maybe" as one control.
- InputGroup is an input with addons (leading label / trailing hint).
- Field is a generic field wrapper when FormControl is too opinionated.

Card.description: Vertical container for all content in a chat response. Children stack top to bottom automatically.

TextContent.description: Text block with optional size. size: "small" | "default" | "large" | "small-heavy" | "large-heavy". Cite inline as [n] and the app renders a clickable badge.

MarkDownRenderer.description: Renders markdown text with GFM support and clickable [n] citation badges.

CardHeader.description: Title/description header block for a Card.

Alert.description: Alert banner with icon, title, and description. variant: "default" | "destructive" | "info" | "success" | "warning".

Avatar.description: Circular avatar with image and fallback text.

CodeBlock.description: Syntax-highlighted code block with optional language and title.

Image.description: Displays an image with optional alt text.

Progress.description: Progress bar showing completion percentage (0-100). Optional label.

BarChart.description: Vertical bars comparing a value across categories, or a stacked composition. Use to rank or compare discrete groups. Set meta.title, meta.unit, and both axis labels.

Series.description: One named data series with values matching labels.

LineChart.description: Line chart for a trend across an ordered axis, often time. Use when the shape of change matters more than individual points. Set meta.title, meta.unit, and both axis labels.

AreaChart.description: Filled area chart emphasising magnitude or cumulative volume over an ordered axis. Use for totals/volume, not precise comparisons. Set meta.title, meta.unit, and both axis labels.

PieChart.description: Pie or donut for parts of a whole at one point in time (2-7 slices). Use a bar chart or Table when the reader must compare exact values. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

Slice.description: A single slice in a PieChart or RadialChart.

RadarChart.description: Radar/spider comparing entities across the same 3-8 dimensions on one 0-100 scale. Never mix units on a radar. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

RadialChart.description: Radial bar (concentric rings) for a small ranked set on independent scales or progress per category. Use a bar chart when values share one scale. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

ScatterChart.description: Scatter relating two numeric variables, one point per study. Use to show correlation, clusters, or effect against a baseline. Label both axes and their units in meta.

ScatterSeries.description: Named scatter series with Point references.

Point.description: A single data point in a ScatterChart series.

WaterfallChart.description: Waterfall: how a starting value moves through signed increments to a final total. Use for additive effect decomposition. Mark the last bar total: true. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

WaterfallItem.description: One step in a WaterfallChart. category: step label; value: signed change (negative decreases); total: true renders the running cumulative total bar.

SunburstChart.description: Sunburst: a two-to-four level part-of-whole hierarchy as concentric rings. Use for nested categories; use a pie chart for a flat one-level split. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

SunburstNode.description: One node of a SunburstChart hierarchy. name: unique label; value: leaf size (omit for branch nodes); parent: parent node name (omit for a root).

TreemapChart.description: Treemap: nested part-of-whole as area-proportional rectangles. Use when many categories or two levels must fit at once; pair with a Table for exact values. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

TreemapNode.description: One node of a TreemapChart hierarchy. name: unique label; value: leaf size; parent: parent node name (omit for a root).

FunnelChart.description: Funnel: progressive attrition through ordered stages (screened > eligible > included > analysed). Use for any screening or selection flow. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

FunnelStage.description: One stage in a FunnelChart. name: stage label; value: stage count.

SankeyChart.description: Sankey: how quantities flow between stages or groups. Use for movement/allocation, never simple category totals. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

FlowNode.description: One node (source or target) in a SankeyChart. name: unique label used by FlowLink.

FlowLink.description: One flow in a SankeyChart. source/target: FlowNode names; value: flow magnitude.

GaugeChart.description: Gauge: one headline number against a maximum (pooled estimate, certainty score, completion). Use only for a single KPI, never comparisons. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

HeatmapChart.description: Heatmap matrix: a value at every row x column combination (e.g. outcome x study). Use to expose patterns and gaps across two categorical axes. Always label both axes. Set meta.title and meta.unit.

HeatCell.description: One cell in a HeatmapChart. x: column label; y: row label; value: cell magnitude.

MapChart.description: World map for geographic evidence: shaded countries (regions) and/or located study sites (points). Use for geographic distribution or country-level rates. Any country shading must come from a cited numeric value.

MapPoint.description: One marker on a MapChart. lat/lng: coordinates in decimal degrees; label: place or study name; value: optional magnitude used for the marker size and tooltip.

MapRegion.description: One shaded country on a MapChart. name: country name in common English (United States, China, Brazil); value: magnitude that drives the color scale; label: optional display name.

Table.description: Data table. title: what the table shows (e.g. 'Baseline characteristics by arm'); columns: Col[] with header/type/unit; rows: 2D array of values; caption: source, n, or caveat. Every numeric column should carry its unit.

Col.description: Column definition for Table. header: column name; type: string | number | boolean (numbers are right-aligned); unit: measurement unit shown after the header (e.g. mg, %, RR, 95% CI).

TagBlock.description: Group of tags. Accepts string array or Tag references.

Form.description: Form container with fields and explicit action buttons. fields: FormControl[], buttons: Buttons.

Button.description: Clickable button. variant: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link". size: "default" | "xs" | "sm" | "lg" | "icon". action: { type: "continue_conversation" | "open_url", url? }.

FormControl.description: Wraps a form field with a label and error display.

Blockquote.description: Styled blockquote. Optional cite for attribution.

InlineCode.description: Inline code snippet rendered with monospace font.

PaginationBlock.description: Page navigation. currentPage and totalPages control which pages are shown.

DialogBlock.description: Modal dialog triggered by a button. triggerLabel: button text, title/description in header, content: children rendered inside.

AlertDialogBlock.description: Confirmation dialog with cancel and confirm buttons. Clicking confirm sends the confirmLabel as a message.

DrawerBlock.description: Bottom drawer panel triggered by a button. triggerLabel: button text, title/description in header, content: children rendered inside.

CalendarBlock.description: Standalone calendar display. mode: "single" | "multiple" | "range". captionLayout: "label" | "dropdown" (default "dropdown"). numberOfMonths defaults to 1.

Command.description: Evidence search palette (Cmd+K). placeholder: input hint; items: CommandItem[]; empty: no-results text; dialog: true renders a button that opens the palette modally.

CommandItem.description: One selectable row in a Command palette. label: primary text; description: secondary text; keywords: extra search terms; action: fired on select.

Combobox.description: Searchable select for filtering studies (design, population, intervention). trigger: button label; items: ComboboxItem[]; placeholder: idle text; searchPlaceholder: input hint.

ComboboxItem.description: One option for Combobox. value: unique id; label: visible text; description: secondary text; action: fired on select.

HoverCard.description: Citation preview on hover. trigger: the visible node (e.g. a Badge marker); content: nodes revealed in the card. Never repeat the full citation inline.

Tooltip.description: One-line definition shown on hover. trigger: the term node (e.g. TextContent 'GRADE certainty'); text: the definition. Never parenthesize definitions in prose.

Popover.description: Inline detail on click for a single data point. trigger: the clickable node; content: nodes shown in the floating panel. Use instead of a full Dialog for one number.

Collapsible.description: Single expandable section for nested evidence (e.g. subgroup analyses). trigger: header node; content: revealed nodes; defaultOpen: start expanded.

ToggleGroup.description: Study-design filter as toggle buttons (e.g. RCT / Cohort / Case-control). items: labels; multiple: allow more than one on; defaultValue: initially active label. Never write "you can filter by..." in prose.

Sheet.description: Side panel for full-text context without covering the answer. trigger: button text; side: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left" (default right); title/description: header; content: panel nodes.

Resizable.description: Side-by-side evidence comparison with a draggable divider. panels: ResizablePanel[]; direction: "horizontal" | "vertical"; initialRatio: first-pane percent (2 panes only). Use instead of stacking two tables.

ResizablePanel.description: One pane of a Resizable. content: nodes rendered inside the pane.

ScrollArea.description: Fixed-height scroll region for long evidence lists, so the Card cannot grow unbounded. content: nodes; orientation: scroll axis; maxHeight: pixel cap (default 320).

Sonner.description: Transient toast for confirmations ("Citation copied", "Filter applied"). message: toast body; variant: tone; label: button text (default "Notify"); description: secondary line. Never use a permanent Alert for a transient confirmation.

Skeleton.description: Streaming placeholder. Match width/height to the component that will replace it to prevent layout shift. width/height accept px numbers or CSS strings; rounded: none | sm | md | lg | full.

Spinner.description: Inline loading indicator while a single passage resolves. label: optional text.

Empty.description: Empty state when a filter returns zero studies, e.g. title "No RCTs match this population". title: headline; description: explanation; content: optional actions.

Field.description: Generic form field wrapper when FormControl is too opinionated. label: field label; control: the input node; description: helper text.

Breadcrumb.description: Research trail showing how the evidence set was narrowed (Question > Filtered evidence (12) > Included studies (5) > Synthesis). items: BreadcrumbItem[]; the last item renders as the current page.

BreadcrumbItem.description: One step in a Breadcrumb. label: step text; href: link target; action: fired when a non-link step is clicked.

NavigationMenuItem.description: One top-level section. trigger: section label; content: nodes revealed in the dropdown.

DropdownMenu.description: Row-level actions opened from a button. trigger: button text; items: DropdownMenuItem[]; label: optional group heading.

DropdownMenuItem.description: One row action (e.g. "Show abstract", "Open in PubMed", "Exclude"). label: row text; action: fired on select; variant: "default" | "destructive".

ContextMenu.description: Right-click actions on a passage. trigger: the region node; items: ContextMenuItem[]; label: optional heading.

ContextMenuItem.description: One right-click action (e.g. "Copy citation", "Highlight", "Compare"). label: row text; action: fired on select.

Menubar.description: Desktop-style menu bar for a full research console. menus: MenubarMenu[].

MenubarMenu.description: One top-level menubar menu. trigger: menu label; items: MenubarItem[].

MenubarItem.description: One action inside a MenubarMenu. label: row text; action: fired on select.

Kbd.description: Keyboard shortcut display. keys: one string ("Cmd+K") or a string array rendered as a combo.

AspectRatio.description: Constrain an image thumbnail or forest-plot preview to a fixed ratio. ratio: width / height (e.g. 1.7778 for 16:9); content: nodes.

ButtonGroup.description: Group related actions without spacing, e.g. "Include / Exclude / Maybe" as one control. buttons: Button[].

InputGroup.description: Input with addons, e.g. a search field with a leading filter label and a trailing hint. placeholder: input hint; addonStart/addonEnd: text on either side.

FollowUpBlock.description: List of follow-up suggestion chips at the end of a response.

FollowUpItem.description: Clickable follow-up suggestion — sends text as user message when clicked.

Tabs.description: Tabbed content. items: TabItem[]. defaultValue: initially active tab.

TabItem.description: Tab panel. value: unique id, trigger: tab label, content: children.

Carousel.description: Horizontal sliding content. slides: array of slide arrays. variant: "default" | "card".

Label.description: Form label. Optionally links to an input via htmlFor.

Input.description: Text input field. type: "text" | "email" | "password" | "number" | "url". rules for validation.

TextArea.description: Multi-line text input. rows sets visible height. rules for validation.

Select.description: Dropdown select. items: SelectItem[], placeholder, rules for validation.

DatePicker.description: Date selection input with calendar popover.

Slider.description: Range slider input. min, max, step, defaultValue.

SwitchGroup.description: Group of toggle switches. items: SwitchItem[].

AccordionItem.description: Collapsible item inside Accordion. value: unique id, trigger: header text.
